: Here's what happened to me:

: I bled a fellow methuselah for 1 bleed. He telepathic countered it to
: zero blood. I then played "Spy Mission". The rest of the people in
: the game told me "YOU CAN'T DO THAT!" I ask why...

Here's some rulings:

Spying Mission - Action Modifier (ob):

Is only played if you know the bleed is successful, i.e., after you
would normally play action modifiers. [TOM 960226]

Is only played after all Reaction cards (as well as other Action
Moifiers) have been played. In particular, Telepathic Counter no
longer 'beats' Spying Mission unless it is played first (and the
bleed is not boosted back to positive). [TOM 960303]

After successfully being played, it must be burned on the next
unblocked bleed against the same Methuselah, provided the bleed is
not reduced to zero by other modifiers. [TOM]

The bleed it is played on is considered unsuccessful. Previous Spying
Missions won't be cashed in during that action. [RTR 960530]

TOM rulings were handed down by Tom Wylie when he was the official WotC
net representative. If there are numbers, they indicate _when_ the ruling
was handed down. The funny thing about rulings is making sure you read them
correctly. Note: Telepathic Counter no longer 'beats' Spying Mission
UNLESS it is played first... and in your case, telepathic counter WAS
played first. Also, the rulings state that you MUST wait until it was a
"successful" bleed, so after most Action Mod.'s are played... so one really
can't play telepathic counter afterwards...

: I'd just like to know how many other people out their share my
: warped logic (possibly inherited from Magic) and would appreciate
: any comments.

If I didn't know about the rulings, I _might_ have gone with you...

Messages.Author: John Kroetch
Messages.Body:
Hello...

I'd like to ask you knowledgable people about the card "Spy Mission"
in Jyhad.

Here's what happened to me:

I bled a fellow methuselah for 1 bleed. He telepathic countered it to
zero blood. I then played "Spy Mission". The rest of the people in

the game told me "YOU CAN'T DO THAT!" I ask why... the card does not
specifically say anything like "after a SUCCESSFUL bleed" or "you must
remove pool". It just says "INSTEAD of removing pool, play spy
mission". Now, I look at it as "INSTEAD" of removing ZERO pool, I
play spy mission. However, I am greatly outnumbered by my friends
here (about 5 to 1), and I doubt I am right. I'd just like to know

how many other people out their share my warped logic (possibly
inherited from Magic) and would appreciate any comments.

thanks!

John
